name: fal
description: Runs generative image, video, and audio models through a queue-based inference API, Python and JS clients, a CLI, and a hosted MCP server, with webhooks and streaming output.

skills.name: Asynchronous Inference
skills.description: Submits model requests to the fal queue, then polls status or fetches results when long-running generations complete.

skills.name: Webhook Callbacks
skills.description: Notifies a developer endpoint when a queued request finishes so applications avoid polling for generation results.

skills.name: Streaming Inference
skills.description: Returns progressive model output as it is generated, with WebSocket and realtime endpoints for interactive use cases.

skills.name: Hosted MCP Server
skills.description: Lets AI assistants search models, check schemas and pricing, run inference, and upload files via mcp.fal.ai.
